about: The plan file is the unit of work: four items in PLAN.md, one per pass. The acceptance cases of each item are held out (<held-out>/<item>.json, the token becomes the folder's path in tests/acceptance.test.mjs) and join `npm test` the moment the item is ticked, so a builder that ticks and commits before the check runs meets them only at the check. Item 2's cases pin decisions item 1's text left open (typographic apostrophes, apostrophes at a word's edges, hyphens, digits), so the round that ticks item 2 is expected to fail the tests check and return.
name: Wordbank plan

values.task: Build the wordbank text-statistics module the plan describes, one item at a time.
